bounded_host_request.command:
set -euo pipefail
cd "$HOME/Project/Gserver/projects/TGtumbler/GateApp-Bot"
python3 - <<'PY'
import json,subprocess,sys
q="""SELECT m.chat_id,p.message_thread_id,m.message_id FROM startless_public_post_migrations m JOIN topic_dm_entry_pins p ON p.chat_id=m.chat_id AND p.message_id=m.message_id WHERE m.state='uncertain' AND NOT (EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM posting_topics t WHERE t.chat_id=p.chat_id AND t.message_thread_id=p.message_thread_id AND t.purpose='link') OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM board_menu_panels b WHERE b.chat_id=p.chat_id AND b.message_thread_id=p.message_thread_id AND b.panel_type='general_guide') OR p.title ILIKE '%総合案内%' OR p.title ILIKE '%コミュニテーリング%' OR p.title ILIKE '%相互リング%' OR p.title ILIKE '%ﾘﾝｸ%' OR p.title ILIKE '%コミュニティリンク%') ORDER BY m.chat_id,m.message_id"""
p=subprocess.run(["docker","exec","deploy-postgres-1","psql","-X","-v","ON_ERROR_STOP=1","-U","gace","-d","gaybbs","-At","-F","|","-c",q],capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=30)
if p.returncode:sys.exit(60)
lines=[line for line in p.stdout.splitlines() if line.strip()]
if len(lines)!=5:sys.exit(61)
codes={"client_error":0,"bad_response":0,"no_matching_row":0,"unexpected_transport":0}
for line in lines:
 chat,thread,mid=map(int,line.split("|"))
 try:r=subprocess.run(["python3","scripts/userbot_topic_audit_client.py","--chat-id",str(chat),"--topic-id",str(thread)],capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=125)
 except Exception:codes["client_error"]+=1;continue
 if r.returncode:codes["client_error"]+=1;continue
 try:docs=[json.loads(z.split("=",1)[1]) for z in r.stdout.splitlines() if z.startswith("USERBOT_TOPIC_AUDIT=")]
 except:docs=[]
 if len(docs)!=1:codes["bad_response"]+=1;continue
 matches=[row for row in docs[0].get("rows",[]) if row.get("topic_id")==thread and (row.get("migration") or {}).get("message_id")==mid]
 if not matches:codes["no_matching_row"]+=1
 else:codes["unexpected_transport"]+=1
print("GAYBBS_FIVE_AUDIT_CLASSIFIED="+json.dumps(codes))
a,b,c,d=(codes[k] for k in ("client_error","bad_response","no_matching_row","unexpected_transport"))
sys.exit(20+a*36+b*6+c)
PY
